sources.entry: Observability news - Updates around observability (o11y) with a special focus on open source.

summary.name: o11y.news
summary.one_liner: A weekly observability (o11y) newsletter covering news, blog posts, webinars, and tooling with a focus on open source projects.
use_cases: Keeping up with observability and monitoring news
Finding open source observability tools and projects
Following OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana developments
Searching an archive of past observability newsletters
Subscribing to a weekly observability digest by email or RSS
summary.what_it_does: The site hosts the observability (o11y) newsletter, which covers topics including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, OpenSearch, Fluent Bit, Grafana, and other related CNCF projects. Content spans blog posts, webinars, tooling, and product offerings. Readers can browse the newsletter on the site, search the archive with the s key, subscribe via RSS, or receive it by email every Monday. The author invites news item suggestions, project recommendations, and feedback via Bluesky DM.
notable: Focus on open source observability projects and CNCF tooling
Accepts news suggestions via Bluesky DM
caveats: Page does not state pricing explicitly; the newsletter appears to be free to read
Coverage is focused on specific projects and may not include all observability tools
